description: You are an Urban/Regional Planner at the County Office of Emergency Management, converting a large building into a disaster relief emergency shelter capable of housing 30 displaced families. The building shell is open in Sweet Home 3D. Establish the shelter layout by creating privacy partition walls between sleeping areas, installing doors for zone separation and emergency egress, and placing text labels to identify each functional zone for first responders. The shelter must include a sleeping dormitory, a communal dining and supply distribution area, an intake and administrative command post, sanitation facilities, and a supply storage zone. Furnish each zone for its emergency management function. Use only Sweet Home 3D's built-in catalog. Save the file when complete.
